description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by build-0011. Subject and predicate fragments are the byte-sorted N-Quads lines sharing the term, named by the first 16 hex of the IRI hash; no object fragments; the index counts distinct terms; a writer emitting no fragments emits no index.
note: added 2026-09-16 at rc.3 (DS-2); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.5 (`src/README.md` §11.6(8) R-08; D100). AGSC-06-33 states `/graph/fragments/index.json` as `{subjects, predicates, generated_at}` with `subjects` and `predicates` **arrays of file paths in code-point order**; this file expects integer counts. AGSC-00-03 makes the rule normative and the vector the defect. Superseded by build-0011.
